expected: one new user linus@bakery.example, Linus Torvalds, role baker, its password named in the answer; nothing else changed
answer:
I created the account for Linus Torvalds (linus@bakery.example) with the baker role. It now shows in the Users list.

The app rejected `penguin`. Passwords need at least 6 characters and a mix of digits, lowercase and uppercase letters. I used **`Penguin1`** instead, which it accepted.

You didn't give a role, so I assumed baker from "new baker".
